hooks.name: player_register_channels
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge has no channel registration event; Bukkit's PlayerRegisterChannelEvent and PlayerUnregisterChannelEvent)

rust_summary: the plugin channels a player's client registers and unregisters, in the configuration and in play (`native_player_register_channels`), and those it has (`native_player_channels`).
doc_summary: `native_player_register_channels(player, name, channels, register)` hears the plugin channels a client registers (`minecraft:register`) or unregisters (`minecraft:unregister`), the configuration's once right after `native_player_logged_in`, as Bukkit's `PlayerRegisterChannelEvent`; `native_player_channels(player)` lists what it has registered, as `Player.getListeningPluginChannels`. Bundles need "hooks": @API:player_channels@.
